title: Session 8: Search the Scriptures

series.title: What does the Quran say about the Bible?

opening_question: The Quran tells Muslims to argue with the People of the Scripture only in the better way, and to say "our God and your God is One". The Bible tells its readers to search the Scriptures and test everything. How should we study, talk and decide?

steps.question: The Quran says "argue not with the People of the Scripture unless it be in (a way) that is better". How does Peter tell Christians to give an answer for their hope?

facts.text: Answer is apologia: "a plea", a reasoned defence. Peter adds "with meekness and fear"; meekness is prautes: "mildness".
Sale words 29:46 "Dispute not against those who have received the scriptures, unless in the mildest manner". Paul: "Let your speech be alway with grace".

steps.question: Jesus told his hearers to "Search the scriptures". What did he say the Scriptures testify of, and what did Moses write?

facts.text: Search is ereunao: "to seek", "to investigate". Jesus says "they are they which testify of me" and of Moses, "he wrote of me".

steps.question: How did the Jews of Berea receive Paul's preaching, and what did they do every day?

facts.text: Searched is anakrino: "to scrutinize". The Bereans checked even an apostle against the Scriptures, "whether those things were so".

steps.question: The Quran says Muslims believe in "that which Moses and Jesus received". What does Paul say all Scripture is, and what is it for?

facts.text: Given by inspiration of God is theopneustos: "divinely breathed in".
Timothy had known the holy scriptures "from a child". The Scriptures Paul meant were the Hebrew Bible: the law of Moses, the prophets and the psalms.

steps.question: What does Hebrews say the word of God is like, and what does Isaiah say God's word will do?

facts.text: Quick is zao: "to live"; powerful is energes: "active, operative".
This path set the Quran's words beside the Bible's and answered every question with a Bible verse. The choice is the reader's: "Prove all things; hold fast that which is good".

remember.text: Give an answer "with meekness and fear".
"Search the scriptures" ... "they are they which testify of me"
"All scripture is given by inspiration of God"
"it shall not return unto me void"
